messages:
Priya (SRE Lead): Quick sync: this thread is the canonical follow-up for DR postmortem items we agreed needed concrete owners & acceptance criteria. I split it into micro-sprints so we can show progress in the weekly ops review.

Marco (Network Eng): thanks. can you paste the micro-sprint list? i'll take network/DNS pieces.

Priya (SRE Lead): pasted. reply w/ owner, ETA (date), and DONE condition. keep it short.

Priya (SRE Lead): A) DNS TTL reduction plan for warm-standby failovers — automate TTL lowering during game-day and revert.
Priya (SRE Lead): B) Cross-region snapshot consistency check — deterministic checksum and sample-restore validation across zones.
Priya (SRE Lead): C) Traffic surge sim for failover — synthetic generator + SLA validation (95p latency under X ms).
Priya (SRE Lead): D) Restore orchestration automation — one-click restore play that handles KV priming, migrations, and traffic gating.
Priya (SRE Lead): E) Recurrence dashboard — surface repeat incident signatures (routing flaps, snapshot timeouts) to triage board.

Marco (Network Eng): A) I'll own DNS TTL plan. ETA: 2026-04-08. DONE condition: automation runbook + CI job that toggles TTL and a canary that verifies DNS propagation within target window. Blocker: need access to infra-dns service account.

Jules (Backup Eng): B) I'll own snapshot consistency. ETA: 2026-04-01. DONE condition: automated job that computes checksums + one successful sample restore to staging weekly. Blocker: slow object-store reads in eu-west region (see ticket INC-8500).

Arjun (Oncall): C) synthetic traffic surge — i'll pair with loadgen team. ETA: 2026-04-12. DONE condition: runbook with paramized load profile + pass criteria in CI. Blocker: need test token limiting and isolated prefix.

Kei (Platform PM): D) Restore orchestration automation — i'll drive the requirements and accept. ETA: 2026-04-22. DONE condition: PR merged for orchestration controller + end-to-end test that performs a full restore and verifies KV priming + traffic gate. Blocker: coordination with infra on controller creds.

Priya (SRE Lead): E) recurrence dashboard — i'll own initial MVP and hand over to Observability. ETA: 2 sprints (2026-04-30). DONE: dashboard linked from incident board + weekly auto-email of top 5 signatures.

Marco (Network Eng): Ops note: for DNS toggles we'll expose a dry-run flag and a --revert-after param so we don't forget to revert. sample CLI:

```
# toggle warm-standby TTL to 60s for test prefix, revert after 2h
infra-dns toggle-ttl --prefix test-warm --ttl 60 --revert-after 120m --dry-run
```

Jules (Backup Eng): snapshot job plan (sample cron):

```
# weekly cross-region checksum job on Monday 03:30 UTC
30 3 * * 1 /opt/redwood/bin/xregion-checksum --snapshots recent --regions eu-west,us-west --report /tmp/xchk.json
```

Arjun (Oncall): loadgen snippet (param profile JSON):

```
// load profile example
{"rps": 1200, "p95_latency_ms": 350, "duration_min": 20}
```

Kei (Platform PM): orchestration acceptance criteria (short): 1) idempotent runs, 2) observable steps with trace IDs, 3) auto-rollback on step failure, 4) smoke test verifies KV priming.

Priya (SRE Lead): recording process: every PR must include the tag `dr-postmortem-2026` and a line with: owner | ETA | done_condition | rollback. I'll spot-check before merging.

Marco (Network Eng): created ticket NET-3124 for DNS plan + service account request. link: https://issues.redwood/NET-3124. added assignees and a short runbook stub.

Jules (Backup Eng): opened ticket BACKUP-207 for object-store timeouts + checksum job. linked to INC-8500.

Arjun (Oncall): opened LOAD-98 for surge sim infra + requested isolated prefix (test-prefix-03).

Kei (Platform PM): created epic PLAT-DR-12 to track D and E items. sharing calendar placeholders for a "DR micro-sprint review" weekly 30m slot.

Priya (SRE Lead): OpsBot: create recurring reminder in #incidents for owners to update the follow-up sheet every Friday.

OpsBot: Reminder created: channel=#incidents, cadence=weekly, day=Fri, time=17:00 UTC, tag=dr-followups.

Jules (Backup Eng): ran first checksum run on staging; found checksum mismatch for snapshot 2026-03-28 in us-west-2. Logged details in BACKUP-207.

Priya (SRE Lead): thanks. Jules, please include a failing-restore repro (minimal) and add steps to BACKUP-207. we'll triage tomorrow 09:00 PT.

Marco (Network Eng): service account access granted, NET-3124 updated. starting code changes tonight.

Arjun (Oncall): loadgen infra provisioned in test prefix. scheduling first surge run for 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC.

Kei (Platform PM): quick ask: can we make the micro-sprint deliverable checklist visible in the weekly review deck? if yes i'll template it and drop slides.

Priya (SRE Lead): yes — please add slide per owner with: status, ETA, open blockers, and PR/ticket links.

Marco (Network Eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/net/PR-4122 — dns-ttl-automation (WIP). reviewers: Priya, Lee.

Jules (Backup Eng): BACKUP-207 updated with sample reproduce steps + object-store logs. requested priority bump.

Arjun (Oncall): surge run completed: failed at step 3 with elevated p95 (720ms) due to cache warmup missing in staging. created ticket LOAD-99.

Priya (SRE Lead): action items summary (short): Marco: NET-3124 (DNS) ETA 2026-04-08; Jules: BACKUP-207 (checksums/restore) ETA 2026-04-01; Arjun: LOAD-98/99 (surge sim) ETA 2026-04-12; Kei: PLAT-DR-12 (orchestration) ETA 2026-04-22; Priya: recurrence dashboard ETA 2026-04-30.

Kei (Platform PM): noted. i'll pull these into the sprint board and add acceptance criteria.

Priya (SRE Lead): final note: if owners want help, pair requests -> drop a message here and tag me. we'll re-open this thread for any escalations. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Thread saved and tagged `dr-microsprint`.
